records.title: QUAD STEM Scholarship Scheme (ICCR)
records.deadline_display: 22-Apr-26 Last date of application to be submitted by students

source.publisher: Embassy of India, Dili (Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India)
source.raw_extract: Important timeline for the admission process is as follows: 27-Feb-26 Opening of ICCR A2A Portal (http://a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in/) for submitting the application 22-Apr-26 Last date of application to be submitted by students 31st May 2026 Last date for universities to inform the decision to students 25th June 2026 Last date for allocating scholarship and generating offer letters
source.exact_deadline_wording: 22-Apr-26 Last date of application to be submitted by students
source.notes: The provider's own scheme pages were fetched first and publish no deadline: https://a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in/scheme/quad-stem-scholarship returns a JavaScript-only shell with an error image, and https://a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in/home/scheme lists 'Quad STEM Scholarship Scheme' with a description but no date. The deadline therefore comes from the Ministry of External Affairs tier. The link from the scheme-level deadline to this scheme is that every ICCR application is submitted through the single A2A portal - ICCR's own FAQ (https://iccr.gov.in/scholarship-faqs) states 'Interested applicants should register and apply on A2A ICCR Scholarship Portal' and 'No, only online applications will be accepted' - and the AY 2026-27 A2A window is common to all schemes. Note the figure is the revised date (22 April 2026); earlier AY 2026-27 notices circulated 15 April 2026, but those notices could not be retrieved as readable pages and are not relied on. 22 April 2026 is in the past relative to the retrieval date, so no date is written and the record's open/upcoming status does not match the published source.

records.deadline_display: The 2027-28 Rotary Peace Fellowship application is now closed. The 2028-29 Rotary Peace Fellowship application will be available online in February 2027.

source.raw_extract:
#### **Application timeline**  
The 2027-28 Rotary Peace Fellowship application is now closed. The 2028-29 Rotary Peace Fellowship application will be available [online](https://my.rotary.org/en/peace-fellowship-application "online") in February 2027.
source.exact_deadline_wording: The 2027-28 Rotary Peace Fellowship application is now closed. The 2028-29 Rotary Peace Fellowship application will be available online in February 2027.
source.notes: The provider publishes cycle status but no closing deadline date anywhere on its own fellowship pages fetched (overview, master's degree programs, professional development certificate program). The only calendar month published is the opening month of the next cycle (February 2027), which is an opening, not a closing deadline. The fellowship is therefore an annually recurring cycle with no fixed current closing date published, so per AGENT_BRIEF section 6 no calendar date is written. Rotary district sites (rotary7070.org, rotary6270.org) and scholarship aggregators state a '15 May' closing deadline, but these are not the provider's own domain and were not used as evidence; the claim could not be confirmed on any page fetched from rotary.org or my.rotary.org.

records.title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (JSP)
records.deadline_display: Applications for scholarships should be sent at least six months prior to the planned time that you wish to commence studies.

source.publisher: Asian Development Bank (programme financed by the Government of Japan)
source.raw_extract: Applications for scholarships should be sent at least six months prior to the planned time that you wish to commence studies. ... No separate application to ADB is necessary. The duly accomplished applications form together with all copies of academic records should be sent to the institution at least six (6) months before the commencement of the intake that you wish to join.
source.exact_deadline_wording: should be sent to the institution at least six (6) months before the commencement of the intake that you wish to join
source.notes: ADB publishes no fixed calendar deadline for the JSP. The official procedures page states there is no application to ADB itself and that the application goes to the applicant's chosen designated academic institution at least six months before that institution's intake, i.e. the deadline is institution-led and relative to the intended start of studies. The main JSP page confirms the same institution-routed procedure ('Request for information and application forms from your choice of a partner institution'). With no fixed date anywhere in the official source, the deadline is non-dating and must not be converted into a calendar date.
